context: 日本前衛藝術家草間彌生辭世，享耆壽 97 歲。她的公司 8 月 27 日發布聲明，證實她已於 8 月 14 日在東京的醫院離世。圓點、南瓜、無限鏡屋——她用七十年的創作，把「自我消融」變成全世界都認得的語言。

sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: Japanese artist Yayoi Kusama , whose seven-decade career encompassed painting, sculpture, installation, performance, literature and film, has died at the age of 97. Kusama died at a hospital in Tokyo on August 14, 2026, according to a statement from Yayoi Kusama Inc. and Yayoi Kusama Studio Inc. Known internationally for her polka dots, pumpkins and Infinity Mirror Rooms, Kusama developed a distinctive artistic language around repetition, infinity, self-obliteration and the relationship between the individual and the world.
sources.title: Yayoi Kusama, Artist of Dots, Repetition and Infinity, Dies at 97

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: With dots that dizzied the viewer, the giddy sensory overload of seeing the grandest installations of her octopuses and giant pumpkins was hard to resist • Yayoi Kusama, Japanese artist who became a global superstar, dies aged 97 • A life in pictures I once had an argument about Yayoi Kusama with Peter Gabriel. Not in person – I’ve never met the prog rock hero. But after I recorded some critical comments on her work for the BBC, I watched the segment only to see Gabriel passionately defending her. My onscreen cynicism seemed harsh indeed compared with his soulful appreciation of all those dots. My scepticism about Kusama started the first time I saw her work at the Museum of Modern Art in New York. The context is significant because after a big dose of Jackson Pollock’s looping, tangled forests of colour and line (colour as line), Piet Mondrian’s pulsing Broadway Boogie Woogie and other great abstract art, Kusama’s dots appeared to me static, planned, predictable. I wasn’t excited or moved. Continue reading...
sources.title: Yayoi Kusama’s psychedelic art was at its best when taken in high doses

thread_text:
日本前衛藝術家草間彌生辭世，享耆壽 97 歲。她的公司 8 月 27 日發布聲明，證實她已於 8 月 14 日在東京的醫院離世。1929 年生於松本市，草間彌生的創作橫跨繪畫、雕塑、裝置、行為藝術、文學與電影，長達七十年——圓點、南瓜與無限鏡屋（Infinity Mirror Rooms）是她最為人熟知的印記，重複、無限與自我消融則是貫穿一生的主題。

本則整理自 The Guardian、ArchDaily、Dezeen 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 8 月 27 日發佈的報導。
threads_text:
草間彌生離開了，享耆壽 97 歲。她的公司 8 月 27 日發布聲明，證實這位日本前衛藝術家已於 8 月 14 日在東京的醫院離世。1929 年生於松本市，她的創作生涯長達七十年，橫跨繪畫、雕塑、裝置、行為藝術、文學與電影。圓點、南瓜、無限鏡屋——這些印記讓她從日本的「圈外人」變成全球超級巨星，而貫穿這一切的，是她反覆訴說的主題：重複、無限、自我消融，還有個人與世界的關係。

本則整理自 The Guardian、ArchDaily、Dezeen 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 8 月 27 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
voice_text: 草間彌生離開了，享耆壽九十七歲。她的公司在 8 月 27 日發布聲明——這位日本前衛藝術家，已於 8 月 14 日在東京的醫院離世。一九二九年，她生於松本市。之後的七十年，她畫畫、做雕塑、做裝置、寫作。圓點、南瓜、無限鏡屋——她把這些變成全世界都認得的語言。重複，無限，自我消融。這是她一生反覆訴說的主題。
